title: Passive Voice Quiz 1
description: Build the passive of the present simple, past simple and future with be and the past participle.
instructions: Passive Voice: Simple tenses in the passive.
Read each question carefully, then check your answer.
Every question has a trap. Read every word.

questions.question: Which sentence is the passive of 'They speak English here'?
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am / is / are + past participle, so English is spoken here. Watch out: English is a singular subject, so the helper is is, not are.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: The keys is plural, so be is were, and found is the participle. Watch out: be agrees with the new subject, not with the old one.

questions.question: Cars {{1}} (make) here. This car {{2}} (make) last year.
questions.explanation: Here and every day point to the present simple passive (are made). Last year points to the past simple passive (was made). Watch out: the second helper is singular, because this car is singular.

questions.question: The result {{1}} (announce) tomorrow. Use will.
questions.explanation: Future passive: will + be + past participle. Watch out: be stays in the base form after will.

questions.question: 'The keys was found' is correct.
questions.explanation: The subject is the keys, which is plural, so the sentence is The keys were found. Watch out: the verb agrees with the new subject.

questions.question: Which sentence is the passive of 'Someone stole my bike'?
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was + past participle. Watch out: the participle of steal is stolen, not stole.

questions.question: Choose the missing helper in each passive sentence.

rows.given: They make cars here. Cars ___ made here.
Someone cleaned the room. The room ___ cleaned.
They will repair the road. The road ___ repaired.
They sell milk here. Milk ___ sold here.
Thieves stole the paintings. The paintings ___ stolen.

questions.explanation: The tense of the active verb decides the helper. Watch out: milk is singular and paintings is plural.

questions.question: Match each tense with its passive formula.
right: am / is / are going to be + past participle
questions.explanation: Be takes the tense and the main verb becomes a past participle. Watch out: going to stays in the passive, and be follows it.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.explanation: The subject comes first, then was, then the participle, then the time phrase. Watch out: built is the participle, not the base form.

questions.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: The window was broken last night.
The cakes were baked by Maria.
The report will be sent tomorrow.
The house is build next year.
questions.explanation: The correct sentences use the right form of be and a past participle. Watch out: speak and build are base forms, so they cannot follow be.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the passive?
questions.explanation: We were given homework puts the receiver of the action first, with was / were + participle. Watch out: The teacher is giving homework is active, even though it is in a continuous tense.

questions.question: Correct the mistake: The cake was eat by the children.
accepted: The cake was eaten by the children.
The cake was eaten by the children
questions.explanation: The passive needs the past participle: eaten. Watch out: eat is the base form and ate is the past form.
